name: NGO Technology Leadership CV

content:

name: UN Personal History Preparation Guide
description: A structured worksheet for P11 / Personal History Profile preparation.
content:
PERSONAL HISTORY PREPARATION

1. Employment history with exact dates
2. Duties and quantified achievements for every role
3. Supervisors and contact information
4. Education and certifications
5. Languages and proficiency
6. References
7. Geographic mobility and availability
8. Publications and memberships

Verify all entries against official documents before submission.

name: Consultancy Technical Proposal
description: A reusable technical-proposal structure for consulting assignments.
content:
TECHNICAL PROPOSAL

1. Understanding of the assignment
2. Proposed methodology and approach
3. Work plan and deliverables
4. Governance and communication
5. Risk management and quality assurance
6. Relevant experience
7. Team / consultant qualifications
8. Availability and assumptions

Replace every section with assignment-specific evidence.

name: Consultancy Financial Proposal
content:
FINANCIAL PROPOSAL

Professional fees: [amount / currency]
Estimated days: [days]
Daily rate: [rate]
Travel and subsistence: [if allowed]
Other reimbursable expenses: [if allowed]
Taxes: [state treatment]
Total: [amount]
Validity period: [days]

Follow the solicitation format when one is provided.

name: Europass CV Preparation Checklist
description: Checklist for roles requesting Europass format.
content:
EUROPASS PREPARATION CHECKLIST

• Personal information and professional headline
• Work experience in reverse chronology
• Education and training
• Language skills using CEFR levels
• Digital skills
• Management and leadership skills
• Projects, publications and memberships
• Data-processing consent where required

Use the official Europass builder when the vacancy explicitly requests it.

name: Healthcare Technology CV

content:
